# MyConsulting Network (MyCo)

> AI-powered consulting for small businesses. MyCo helps small businesses grow with AI: websites that convert, automation that answers every call and follows up with every lead, and practical consulting that pays for itself. Fraction of agency prices, a dedicated project manager on every project, done in weeks not months.

- Website: https://myconsulting.network
- Contact: info@myconsulting.network
- Founded: 2023
- Model: consulting network / project broker - vetted consultants plus a dedicated project manager on every project, 24/7 support, response within 24 hours. Trusted by 12+ growing businesses.

## Services (with starting prices)

1. **AI Growth Website** - conversion-focused website rebuilt with SEO foundations, analytics, and lead capture. From $1,500, ~2-week delivery.
2. **AI Receptionist & Chatbot** - 24/7 website chat, missed-call text-back, FAQ answers, and appointment booking. From $750 setup + $150/mo.
3. **Workflow Automation Sprint** - automate quotes, invoicing, scheduling, lead follow-up, and admin busywork with AI + tools like Zapier/Make. From $1,000 per sprint.
4. **Local SEO & AI Visibility** - Google Business Profile optimization, reviews engine, local rankings, and visibility in AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews). From $500/mo.
5. **AI Marketing Engine** - content + email systems, CRM setup, and social presence run with AI leverage. From $750 setup + $400/mo.
6. **Custom Projects & Fractional Consulting** - dashboards, custom software, feasibility studies, business plans, cloud architecture. Typical projects $1,500-$5,000, scoped free.

Free lead-in offer: **Free AI Opportunity Audit** - a 30-minute call plus a written 5-point action plan showing where AI saves the business time and money, delivered within 48 hours, no obligation.

## Industries served

- Home & field services (landscaping, contractors, cleaning, HVAC)
- Trucking & logistics
- Restaurants, local retail & entertainment
- Professional services (law, accounting, financial advisory)
- Healthcare & wellness (dental, med spa, chiropractic, clinics)
- Real estate & property management
- Also: education/STEM programs and early-stage tech startups

Past clients include Tabletop Village, Blue Landscaping, VOPPL AR, Goldstein & Company, Gibraltar Business Group, Presidential Transpo, Atlantis STEM, and Thind Transport.

## How to engage

Request the Free AI Opportunity Audit or email info@myconsulting.network. MyCo responds within 24 hours, scopes projects free, and assigns a dedicated project manager to every engagement.
